result.instructions: Tools for KnowledgeOwl, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes KnowledgeOwl data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run knowledgeowl_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run knowledgeowl_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run knowledgeowl_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. knowledgeowl_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_request
tools.title: Raw read request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any KnowledgeOwl API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the base, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/article.json?_page=2" or "/category/abc123.json". Returns the parsed JSON.

path.description: Full API path after the base, starting with "/", e.g. "/article.json?_page=2".

tools.name: create_article
tools.title: Create an article
tools.description: MUTATES KnowledgeOwl data: creates a new article. KnowledgeOwl API: POST /article.json (JSON). Required by the API: project_id, name, status, url_hash, visibility, and current_version (a nested object `{ <lang>: { title, body, ... } }` — pass it via the `fields` passthrough). Returns the created article.

project_id.description: The knowledge base (project) id this article belongs to (required).

fields.description: Additional documented KnowledgeOwl fields to send in the JSON write body (e.g. current_version, body) — merged OVER the typed fields above.

tools.name: update_article
tools.title: Update an article
tools.description: MUTATES KnowledgeOwl data: updates an existing article. KnowledgeOwl API: PUT /article/{id}.json (JSON — only included fields change). Use the `fields` passthrough for current_version (title/body) and any other documented field. The path id is never sent in the body.

id.description: The article id to update (path only; required).

fields.description: Additional documented KnowledgeOwl fields to send in the JSON write body (e.g. current_version, body) — merged OVER the typed fields above.

project_id.description: The knowledge base (project) id this category belongs to (required).
